messages:
ravi: Heads-up: seeing sporadic 502s from prod-eu on /api/generate since 23:58 UTC. Small header-parse fix is ready (sha: d4f9e7). Requesting expedited deploy in 00:30-01:00 UTC window.

deploybot: Deploy request queued for redwood/api:hotfix-d4f9e7. Canary plan: 10% for 5m -> 100% if healthy. Ack with +1.

elaine (eng-oncall): +1. Ran staging smoke against hotfix image; sample request returned 200. No token-encoding warnings.

mike (sre): +1. Rollback commands ready. Will monitor ingress error rate and pod restarts.

ravi: Rollback (image swap): `kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:main -n prod-eu`

ravi: Rollback (undo): `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n prod-eu --to-revision=58`

deploybot: Canary started at 00:33 UTC (10%). Metrics: https://console.redwood/metrics/prod-eu?job=canary

elaine: Canary looks clean at +4m. No 5xx spike. Recommend promote at +6m.

deploybot: Promoting to 100% at 00:40 UTC... complete.

mike: Dashboards green. Final smoke passed. Published note: "Hotfix d4f9e7: fix header parsing causing intermittent 502s in EU."
